final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.throws AS t, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS c FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.t AS t, s1.c AS c, s1.c * 1.0 / s2.tot AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL AND s2.tot <> 0), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.t, s3.c, s3.share, s3.share - s4.a AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.share > s4.a) SELECT SUM(c), AVG(share), AVG(d) FROM s5
